name: nv3d-studio
description: NV3D Studio — AI-powered 3D generation, inspection, and GLB export platform orchestrated by NVIDIA NIM MiniMax M3.1 Flash

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @nv3d/backend" "npm run dev -w @nv3d/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nv3d/shared && npm run build -w @nv3d/backend && npm run build -w @nv3d/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @nv3d/shared && npm run typecheck -w @nv3d/backend && npm run typecheck -w @nv3d/frontend
